properties.name: The open ladder is built; reflow2 declares a `part` rung and the backends nest where they live
properties.rationale:
⭐ THE COMPILER CAUGHT WHAT REVIEW WOULD HAVE MISSED. Adding the `UnknownLevel` variant broke three exhaustive matches in `detect.rs` — source, severity and title. That is the `#[non_exhaustive]` finding from the absorption paying off: the enum is reflow2's own now, so a new variant is a BUILD ERROR rather than a wildcard arm silently swallowing it.

⭐ THE FIRST MODELLING ATTEMPT WAS WRONG AND THE CHECK CAUGHT IT, twice over. Nesting the implementations inside `cmp:byte-store` under the CLOSED ladder gave two `level_mismatch` findings, which is what exposed the floor in the first place; and promoting `byte-store` to `subsystem` would only have pushed the mismatch up into `sys:foundation`. The fix was not a workaround but the feature.

🛑 AND IT SURFACED A REAL DEFECT IN A DIFFERENT COMPONENT, fixed in the same change. `add_component`'s required-field resolver looked its fallback up by STORED PROPERTY NAME and asked for `description` — but a Component stores that text as `purpose`. So the lookup always missed on an existing Component and **EVERY REVISE OF A COMPONENT WAS REFUSED with "no such node exists yet to take it from"**, about a node sitting right there. Found by trying to set `level` on `cmp:rocksdb-backend`; the node came straight back from `get_node` a moment later, which is what made the error's confidence visible as wrong. `Capability` is unaffected because it really does store `description` — which is why the bug survived and why a test covering only Capability would have stayed green. Regression test added that asserts the premise itself: a Component has `purpose` and has no `description`.

⚠️ WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT DONE: `Component.level` is now a plain string, so the schema no longer rejects a typo at write time. That validation moves from the schema to `hierarchy_issues`, which REPORTS rather than refuses. This is the report-don't-judge posture and it is a real trade — a bad level now lands in the graph and is surfaced, instead of being blocked. `seam_coverage`'s `altitude` argument already takes a level string and was left alone; it compares names and never ranks, so an open ladder does not change it.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary:
Implements `dec:the-decomposition-ladder-is-open-not-a-fixed-enum`.

`Component.level` was a closed enum with `component` at rank 0 — a hard FLOOR, so a part of a component could not be expressed at all. It is now a plain string naming a rung on THIS design's ladder, declared as `Project.decomposition_levels` (a `list:string`, ordered bottom-first). Absent means the built-in `DEFAULT_RUNGS` — the same five names in the same order — so nothing that predates this moves and no data migrates.

`hierarchy.rs::Level` (an enum with a `rank()` match arm) becomes `Ladder`, a struct over the declared rungs. **`Ladder::rank()` returns `None` for a name that is not on the ladder — never `Some(0)`.** The old `Level::from_key` mapped anything unrecognised to `Component`, so a typo silently became the finest rung and every containment above it read as a mismatch nobody could explain. That silent fallback is gone, and the ordering now has exactly ONE home instead of being declared in both the YAML and the Rust.

New finding `unknown_level` replaces the validation the enum used to give: an off-ladder level is reported BY NAME, and every level-arithmetic check skips that component rather than ranking it. It surfaces as a gap at severity 0.55.

DEMONSTRATED ON THIS DESIGN, end to end through the MCP surface: `proj:reflow2` now declares `[part, component, subsystem, system, system_of_systems, enterprise]`, and `cmp:rocksdb-backend` / `cmp:memory-backend` moved from `sys:foundation` to `cmp:byte-store` at the new `part` rung — where they actually live, in one file. `move_component` returned `level_note: null` (exactly one rung apart) and `hierarchy_issues` is 0 across the whole design.

Six new hierarchy tests, including a four-deep non-software ladder (organelle ▸ cell ▸ tissue ▸ organ ▸ organism) that nests cleanly and still catches a skipped rung — proving rank comes from POSITION, not from any name reflow2 knows.

Core 1,458 / 0 (was 1,452), workspace 1,766 / 0 (was 1,760).
